history.title: feat: progressive delivery via Argo Rollouts + Prometheus-gated auto-rollback
history.author: siri
history.summary: Replaces the plain Deployment with a canary Rollout gated on a live Prometheus query. Architecturally significant — this is the change that makes self-healing possible.
reasons: Replaces the core Deployment with a new resource kind (Rollout)
Introduces a new automated-rollback code path with no prior production history
Changes how traffic reaches every pod during a deploy
recommendedTests: Verify a healthy rollout promotes to 100% automatically
Verify a broken rollout aborts and rolls back automatically
Confirm the stable version keeps serving traffic during an aborted canary

history.title: fix: three real bugs found by actually running the canary rollout live
history.author: siri
history.summary: Fixes a Service with zero endpoints (label mismatch), a crashing analysis query (missing metric dependency), and a Grafana panel with the same missing-metric issue.
reasons: Touches the live traffic-routing Service selector
Changes the query the canary health-check depends on
Found only by actually running the system, not by review alone
recommendedTests: Confirm the Service has matching endpoints after the label fix
Confirm the analysis query returns real values from Prometheus

history.title: fix(docker): patch base image CVEs before they hit the Trivy gate
history.author: siri
history.summary: Bumps the nginx base image and adds `apk upgrade` at build time. Verified: 0 CRITICAL/HIGH findings on the resulting image.
reasons: Base image change could subtly alter runtime behavior
Verified clean with a real Trivy scan before this was merged
recommendedTests: Re-run Trivy against the built image
Confirm the app still serves correctly

history.title: perf: drop alertmanager/node-exporter/kube-state-metrics from monitoring stack
history.author: siri
history.summary: Removes three monitoring components nothing in this project actually reads. No application code touched.
reasons: No app code or traffic path touched
recommendedTests: Confirm the canary AnalysisTemplate still resolves without the removed metrics

selfHealing.description: A live canary rollout was deliberately broken to verify Argo Rollouts' Prometheus-gated analysis actually catches and reverts a bad deploy.

events.label: Broken canary detected and rolled back automatically
events.detail: failed (3) > failureLimit (2) -> RolloutAborted, traffic reverted to the previous stable version, zero manual intervention

topFailureCauses.cause: Custom resource kinds kustomize doesn't recognize

trivy.note: Verified locally with `trivy image --severity CRITICAL,HIGH` after bumping the base image and adding apk upgrade at build time.

cosign.note: Sign/verify/attest mechanics validated locally against a throwaway key and registry; production signing is keyless via GitHub OIDC once pushed.
